searchUrls.title: Kleinanzeigen search URLs
searchUrls.description: Search result pages copied from kleinanzeigen.de with any filters set on the site (category, city and radius, price, private or commercial, category attributes...). Each URL is one search.

queries.title: Keywords
queries.description: Or build searches here. One search per keyword, e.g. fahrrad, iphone 15, wohnung, playstation 5.

location.title: City or postcode
location.description: Optional, e.g. Berlin, München, 50667. Empty searches all of Germany.

radiusKm.title: Radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Used with a city or postcode. Kleinanzeigen offers 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 150 and 200; other values are rounded up.

includeDetails.title: Full description, attributes and seller
includeDetails.description: Opens each ad for its full description, attributes (condition, type, size...), all photos, shipping, state, and the seller's name, private or commercial, active since, ads online and badges. Slower. $0.0025 per ad instead of $0.001.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max ads per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Newest first. Kleinanzeigen shows 1,250 per search; bigger searches are split by price automatically (ads without a price are then left out).
